summary.name: iHosts
summary.one_liner: iHosts is a macOS app for editing the /etc/hosts file, organizing host entries into groups and switching between combinations with one click.
use_cases: grouping hosts entries for development or testing
viewing hosts file changes in real time
summary.what_it_does: iHosts is a macOS app for editing the /etc/hosts file. It lets you organize hosts entries into groups and freely combine different groups, switching between them with one click. It shows hosts entries in real time and runs in a sandbox mode for safer operation. The page describes its interface as native to macOS.
notable: Groups for organizing hosts entries and one-click switching between combinations
Listed on Mac App Store; awesome-mac lists it as Freeware
caveats: The page does not state paid tiers; awesome-mac marks it Freeware
